title: Gram determinant with first vector orthogonal to the rest: Γ(b, w) = ‖b‖²·Γ(w)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, b ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P) and w = (w_0, …, w_{k−1}) with every w_i ∈ ℝ^P, and assume ⟨b, w_j⟩ = 0 for every j < k. For a finite family v of vectors of ℝ^P let Γ(v) := det[⟨v_i, v_j⟩]_{i,j}, i.e. Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)) (Γ of the empty family is 1). Write (b, w) := Fin.cons b w = (b, w_0, …, w_{k−1}) (a family indexed by Fin (k+1)). Then Γ(b, w) = ‖b‖²·Γ(w).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (b : Euclid P) (w : Fin k → Euclid P), (∀ j : Fin k, inner ℝ b (w j) = 0) → Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (k + 1) => inner ℝ ((Fin.cons b w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) i) ((Fin.cons b w : Fin (k + 1) → Euclid P) j)) = ‖b‖ ^ 2 * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin k => inner ℝ (w i) (w j))
